title: Drop stale zstd:chunked annotations when a reused layer is no longer chunked
body:
Fixes #123.

When a layer is reused with a different compression, updatedBlobInfoFromReuse cloned the original annotations as-is, so a gzip layer could end up carrying zstd:chunked annotations that describe the original blob's TOC. The code even had a FIXME noting this.

This change strips the chunked annotations when the reused blob's final compression is not zstd:chunked, using the existing annotationsAfterCompressionChange helper, before the new compression annotations are merged. If the layer stays chunked, the annotations are kept and the fresh TOC value still merges in.

Added three cases to TestUpdatedBlobInfoFromReuse: chunked -> gzip and chunked -> decompressed (annotations dropped), chunked -> chunked (annotations kept, new manifest-checksum merged).

Verified locally with Go 1.27.4 (-tags containers_image_openpgp): the two new non-chunked cases fail before the fix and pass after; the full copy package suite, go vet, and gofmt are clean.
